title: No empty-catalog initialization path for an isolated dev daemon
wanted_capability: A supported way to initialize an empty catalog-v2 store for a throwaway/isolated blackboxd so collector-backchannel onboarding works from scratch. Remote onboarding requires the daemon to start in catalog mode, but the offline catalog CLI only adds to an existing catalog; a fresh isolated state dir has none. Possibly addressable via the migration workflow (unverified). Blocks reproducible live-validation scripts that stand up a daemon from nothing (docs/operations-isolated-dev-daemon.md flows) and onboard a project through the real backchannel.
fallback_used: Investigate the migration workflow as the bootstrap route in the live-exercise script; if that fails, document manual store seeding.
resolution_note: Genesis path shipped and folded to beta/blackbox-v2 (feat/catalog-genesis @ e63fa08e, verify bbox-verify-4988v): blackbox project-catalog genesis initializes an empty FreshV2 catalog for a fresh state bundle. Correction to the original framing: the six immutable_lane_missing lanes needed no empty representation because they are migration inventory evidence, not catalog content; the FreshV2 origin discriminant already specified the fresh shape (durable-project-catalog-impl.md), and genesis is the missing operator surface over it, byte-identical to the library initializer by test. Guarded by a 21-class owner census with named refusals, empty-legacy set-aside, catalog-mode boot parity, and backchannel admission over a genesis store. Runbook updated.
